vorath_s2.title: Uncle Vorath Mysteries: The Null-Time Discrepancy
vorath_s2.subtitle: SEASON 2 · ISSUE 1

pages.label: Cover
pages.alt: Uncle Vorath, the Grey detective, with the amber chronometer in an occult archive.

pages.label: Plate 1
pages.title: THE SUMMONS TO SECTOR ZERO
pages.alt: THE SUMMONS TO SECTOR ZERO — narrative illustration
captions: OCTOBER 1993 WAS SUPPOSED TO HAVE 31 DAYS. AT 03:00 AM, SECTOR ZERO ONLY SHOWED 29.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: A city can lose its power grid. It can even lose its government. But when a city misplaces forty-eight hours of its own calendar, somebody has committed grand theft time.

dialogue.speaker: ARCHIVIST OAKHAVEN
dialogue.text: Magistrate Vorath! It happened during the shift change. Ledger 74 was locked in the reinforced vault. When we checked the microfiche, two dates had vanished.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Show me the recording instruments. A chronological tear always leaves an electrical scar.

pages.label: Plate 2
pages.title: THE REDACTED LEDGER
captions: THE ARCHIVAL CATACOMBS: MILES OF RUSTED IRON SHELVES EXTENDING INTO ABSOLUTE BLACKNESS.
AT THE END OF AISLE FOUR: THE ANCIENT BRASS RECEIVER STILL SMOKING IN THE DARK.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Paper doesn't just dissolve into mist. Notice the scorched edges along the binding. This wasn't physical theft. It was thermal redaction.

dialogue.speaker: ARCHIVIST OAKHAVEN
dialogue.text: We heard a strange rhythm rattling through the telegraph line twenty minutes before the alarm. It sounded like Morse code, but running backwards!

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Stand back, Oakhaven. The ticker tape is still feeding out. It's printing at 03:14:02.

pages.label: Plate 3
pages.title: THE TELEGRAPH (FULL SPLASH)
captions: EXHIBIT ALPHA: VORATH EXAMINES THE ARRESTED CHRONOMETER AND THE CHARRED PROTOCOL.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Every character stamped on this brass ribbon is stamped with the watermark of the Saturnian Chrono-Cartel. They've found a backdoor into our calendar.

pages.label: Plate 4
pages.title: THE 60-CYCLE VACUUM
captions: THE CHRONO-ACOUSTIC TEST: VORATH RELEASES A SINGLE TUNED CALIPER STRIKE.
VORATH OPENS THE BACK OF THE ARRESTED CHRONOMETER.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Listen. Reality normally vibrates with a sixty-cycle hum. When time is deleted, it leaves a localized vacuum. Hear that silence? That is an absence of forty-eight hours.

dialogue.speaker: ARCHIVIST OAKHAVEN
dialogue.text: Why October 14th and 15th, 1993? What happened on those two days that someone would spend millions of astral credits to erase?

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Those were the exact forty-eight hours when the Oregon Botanical Sanctuary charter was first registered. If those days don't exist, the entire sanctuary lease reverts to the Cartel.

pages.label: Plate 5
pages.title: THE PHANTOM INTEREST LEDGER
pages.alt: THE PHANTOM INTEREST LEDGER — narrative illustration
captions: THE FINANCIAL AUDIT: UNRAVELING THE DERIVATIVE ENGINE BEHIND THE TIME THEFT.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: They didn't just steal forty-eight hours to hide them. They deposited them into an offshore chrono-escrow in the rings of Saturn. At compounding temporal interest over thirty-three years, that forty-eight hours is now worth four centuries of uncollected taxes!

dialogue.speaker: ARCHIVIST OAKHAVEN
dialogue.text: That means every citizen living under the charter is technically in default of their chronological lease!

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: Not while I still carry the seal of the Magistrate.

pages.label: Plate 6
pages.title: THE GLASS BAILIFF'S SHADOW
pages.alt: THE GLASS BAILIFF'S SHADOW — narrative illustration
captions: PINNED TO THE DESK WITH A SHARD OF TRANSLUCENT FUSED SILICA.
VORATH POCKETS THE CRYSTALLINE EVIDENCE SHARD.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: They didn't just send a telegraph. They dispatched an enforcement construct. Look at this signature: 'The Glass Bailiff'.

dialogue.speaker: ARCHIVIST OAKHAVEN
dialogue.text: An autonomous legal automaton! It has no conscience, no pulse, and no jurisdiction under living common law!

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: If the bailiff wants to impound our citizens' REM sleep, it'll have to serve me first.

pages.label: Plate 7
pages.title: THE REVELATION
captions: THE SOURCE OF THE CARRIER FREQUENCY: 800 MILLION MILES OUT, IN THE RINGS OF SATURN.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: The signal isn't coming from Earth. It's routed through a high-frequency sub-space relay orbiting Titan. That's where they keep the master ledger of stolen seconds.

dialogue.speaker: ARCHIVIST OAKHAVEN
dialogue.text: You're going out there? To the edge of the system? Alone?

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: I'm not alone, Oakhaven. I'm bringing forty years of unyielding judicial precedent with me.

pages.label: Plate 8
pages.title: CLIMAX & ISSUE 2 TEASER
captions: THE MIDNIGHT EXPRESS CLEARS THE ATMOSPHERE. THE QUANTUM DOCKET IS FORMALLY OPENED.

dialogue.speaker: UNCLE VORATH
dialogue.text: They stole our time. I'm going to take it back with compound damages.

pages.label: Cover
pages.alt: Blaze, Vorath and Professor Myrcene in the living mycelial cavern.

pages.label: Plate 1
pages.title: THE MORNING TREMOR
captions: DAWN OVER THE WILLAMETTE SOLARIUUM. 48 HOURS AFTER THE SUMMER SOLSTICE VICTORY.

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: Feel that in your boots, Professor? That's not the river current. That's deep bedrock hum.

dialogue.speaker: PROFESSOR MYRCENE
dialogue.text: Precisely 7.83 Hertz, Blaze! The fundamental Schumann resonance of Earth. The ancient root systems have awakened!

dialogue.speaker: VORATH
dialogue.text: The Star Chamber confirms receipt. The planetary aquifer is transmitting an open carrier wave to the Orion Quadrant.

pages.label: Plate 2
pages.title: THE 7.83 HZ CALIBRATION
captions: THE ALCHEMICAL WORKSHOP: PREPARING THE TUNED CEDAR SOUNDING SHIMS.
THE PACK IS SECURED. VORATH TUNES HIS CELESTIAL PENDULUM TO THE BASALT PULSE.

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: We infuse the end-grain with 55-degree cold-cure live hash rosin. That cushions the shockwave so the basalt rings true without cracking.

dialogue.speaker: PROFESSOR MYRCENE
dialogue.text: The mycelium of Mount Hood is over eight thousand years old. It spans three counties under the moss. If we strike the keynote correctly, every tree in Cascadia becomes an antenna!

dialogue.speaker: VORATH
dialogue.text: The entrance lies past the Clackamas headwaters, where the volcanic tube dips beneath the frozen glacier. Follow me.

pages.label: Plate 3
pages.title: THE DESCENT INTO THE FAULT
pages.alt: THE DESCENT INTO THE FAULT — narrative illustration
captions: MILES BENEATH THE CRAGS OF TIMBERLINE LODGE. THE PRIMORDIAL BASALT VAULT OPENS.

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: Look at the grain in this stone. It's stratified like ancient cedar annual rings!

dialogue.speaker: PROFESSOR MYRCENE
dialogue.text: Here! The primary fault crack. It connects directly with the subterranean magma chambers and the Columbia River basalt group.

dialogue.speaker: VORATH
dialogue.text: Prepare the wedge, Blaze. The window of orbital alignment with the Star Chamber is sixty seconds.

pages.label: Plate 4
pages.title: THE STRIKE (FULL SPLASH)
captions: THE MALLET FALLS! TIMBER MEETS STONE WITH ALCHEMICAL PRECISION.

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: FOR CASCADIA! SING, OLD MOUNTAIN!

pages.label: Plate 5
pages.title: THE STAR MAP (PANORAMIC SPLASH)
pages.alt: THE STAR MAP (PANORAMIC SPLASH) — narrative illustration
captions: THE SUBTERRANEAN CATHEDRAL TRANSFORMS INTO A LIVING BIOLOGICAL PLANETARIUM!

dialogue.speaker: VORATH
dialogue.text: Magnificent... It is the complete Star Map of the Galactic Watershed Covenant.

dialogue.speaker: PROFESSOR MYRCENE
dialogue.text: Every fungal node corresponds to a star system! Earth's old growth was never isolated!

pages.label: Plate 6
pages.title: THE INTERSTELLAR DOCKET
captions: VORATH READS THE ROTATING CELESTIAL GLYPHS.
BUT AN ALARM DISRUPTS THE HARMONY: UNLICENSED TELEMETRY DETECTED IN THE HIGH CANOPY.

dialogue.speaker: VORATH
dialogue.text: Under Section 417 of the Astral Codex, the Cascadia Watershed is recognized as a Sovereign Botanical Biosphere.

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: Which means AeroHydra and their synthetic extraction syndicates have zero jurisdiction here!

dialogue.speaker: PROFESSOR MYRCENE
dialogue.text: Wait! My spore wand is picking up jamming signals from 350 feet up in the coastal redwoods!

pages.label: Plate 7
pages.title: THE SIGNAL SPREADS
captions: ACROSS THE COAST RANGE. ELDER SASQUATCH STANDS ON NEAHKAHNIE MOUNTAIN.

dialogue.speaker: SASQUATCH (SUB-BASS TREE KNOCK)
dialogue.text: *THOOM-THOOM-THOOM* (Translation: The mountain has spoken. The Coast Range stands ready.)

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: Sasquatch heard it all the way in Tillamook! The entire watershed is locked in!

dialogue.speaker: VORATH
dialogue.text: We must ascend. To clear the canopy interference, we take the elevator into the giant redwoods.

pages.label: Plate 8
pages.title: CLIMAX & ISSUE 2 TEASER
captions: THE SKY VENT OPENS ABOVE MOUNT HOOD. THE MYCELIAL GATEWAY IS OFFICIALLY ACTIVE!

dialogue.speaker: BLAZIN' BEAVER
dialogue.text: Grab your gear, team. Next stop: 350 feet in the sky!
